positive_window_rule: The three positive-sample windows corresponding to each deposit in the training partition were retained as a group, excluded from unlabeled-sample sampling, and assigned a weight of 1/3 each.
unlabeled_sampling: 10% stratified sampling of unlabeled samples in the outer-training partition; all unlabeled cells in the outer held-out set retained without sampling.
augmentation: Gaussian noise on training-feature tensors only; SD = 0.05 × per-feature training-set SD; window locations and labels unchanged; no spatial rotations or flips.
inner_cv_rule: Among the four outer-training ore fields, samples were divided into four mutually non-overlapping spatial units. Hyperparameters were selected by rotating three units for training and one for validation. The outer held-out ore field was never used for inner selection.
spatial_cv_buffer_rule: A 500 m spatial isolation buffer was established along catchment boundaries between inner-training and inner-validation units; windows overlapping those boundaries were excluded.
prior_note: Main-text operating point is 11×11 and π_tune=0.5, selected by inner spatial cross-validation. π_tune is distinct from KM2 π_stat and from r_geo.
early_stopping_rule: Validation loss monitored; training stopped when validation loss failed to decrease for several consecutive epochs.
variogram_range_note: Protocol distance default in map units converted at 50 m per unit. SCB kriging ranges were fitted independently inside each basin (median 1,167–1,760 m) and are not this global value.
training_seeds_statement: Neural-network random seeds used for OOF-5 training were 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17 and 43.
